description: Strip location (GPS), camera details, time, XMP and IPTC metadata from JPEG, PNG and WebP photos before sharing them. The picture itself is not re-encoded, so it is unchanged byte for byte. Reports what each photo contained. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

files.description: Photos to clean: JPEG, PNG or WebP.

items.description: Path to a file on this computer, absolute or relative to the working directory. Accepts: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp.

saveTo.description: Optional. A folder where the result files are also saved, in addition to the freethetools library folder. It must be inside the working directory, the library, or a folder the person allowed with --allow-save, and not inside a hidden folder. Files that can run programs, such as .bat or .exe, are never saved. Existing files are never overwritten.

name: remove_photo_metadata
title: Remove Photo Location
